releaseNotes:
_Date: 2026-07-01_

---

### ✨ What's New

#### 🧭 Global Studio and Marketplace Access
Compass Partner now surfaces key workspace areas more directly:

- A new **global Studio sidebar view** gives the studio its own dedicated navigation entry.
- **Studio** is now labeled **Agent Studio** throughout the UI for clearer terminology.
- The **Marketplace** now has a dedicated sidebar entry and a fullscreen dialog for more spacious browsing.

---

### 🛠️ Improvements

- **Header and sidebar polish** — global tools were moved into the header, search now lives in headers, the title bar branding was updated to **Nova**, and sidebar top actions were tightened up.
- **Marketplace browsing** — skill details render more cleanly and are easier to scan.
- **Sidebar navigation** — the new More menu gives the sidebar a better home for secondary actions.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Chat history loading** now hides the list while history is still loading.
- **Chat auto-naming** now tolerates persistence races more reliably.
- **ACP session cleanup** now deletes previous sessions correctly.
- **Storage packaging** now bundles sharp runtime dependencies for packaged builds.

---

### ⚙️ Under the Hood

- **Application version metadata** was bumped to **1.0.13**.

_Co-authored by [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)_
